title: Shadow Agent
summary: Shadow Agent is a hooded Swara-Titan who wields a scythe-like axe. He bears green and blue armor which is equipped with large, sharp spines. As a Titan used by the Organization, Shadow Agent is typically paired alongside Doom Warden.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Mr. Wilder gave Shadow Agent's Amulet to Unnamed Suit 054, with Suit 057 being given Doom Warden, as reserve power. After being invoked in battle, Shadow Agent fought Powerbonded Sabriel but was defeated by a charged-up Vigilante after a failed attempt by the Suits to capture Sophie Casterwill. [Gremlow Infestation!]

Shadow Agent was summoned by the same Suit in the battle for the Ring of Umbra in the vault of Hernán Cortés. After a standoff with Kaioh the Tracker, he was held in shock by Enfluxion and then was defeated with a Raypulse cast by Lok Lambert. [The Power of Umbra]

Another Shadow Agent came smashing through the window of Dante Vale's house clutching Emi, a Seeker who he had been pursuing. Dante used Slipsnare to restrict him while Lok hit him with a Touchram, defeating him. Later, when the Huntik team arrived at Emi's house, Mr. Wilder's Suits showed up with two Shadow Agent Titans. In the ensuing fight, they were defeated by Powerbonded Baselaird and Powerbonded Vigilante. Later, in the underwater ruins of Yonaguni, another Shadow Agent was invoked alongside Hoffman's Myrmidon. It was defeated by Powerbonded Pendragon. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Shadow Agent can deal damage to his enemies with the axe he carries. As its name suggests, Shadow Agent is also able to move swiftly and quietly, launching an attack when its enemy least expects it seen when he silently recovered and hit [[Kaioh the Tracker]]. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

After being invoked in battle, Shadow Agent fought Powerbonded Sabriel but was defeated by a charged-up Vigilante after a failed attempt by the Suits to capture Sophie Casterwill. [Gremlow Infestation!]

Shadow Agent was summoned by the same Suit in the battle for the Ring of Umbra in the vault of Hernán Cortés. After a standoff with Kaioh the Tracker, he was held in shock by Enfluxion and then was defeated with a Raypulse cast by Lok Lambert. [The Power of Umbra]

Another Shadow Agent came smashing through the window of Dante Vale's house clutching Emi, a Seeker who he had been pursuing. Dante used Slipsnare to restrict him while Lok hit him with a Touchram, defeating him. Later, when the Huntik team arrived at Emi's house, Mr. Wilder's Suits showed up with two Shadow Agent Titans. In the ensuing fight, they were defeated by Powerbonded Baselaird and Powerbonded Vigilante. Later, in the underwater ruins of Yonaguni, another Shadow Agent was invoked alongside Hoffman's Myrmidon. It was defeated by Powerbonded Pendragon. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

Shadow Agent can deal damage to his enemies with the axe he carries. As its name suggests, Shadow Agent is also able to move swiftly and quietly, launching an attack when its enemy least expects it seen when he silently recovered and hit Kaioh the Tracker. [The Power of Umbra]
